read_scope: Selected original-unit openings, term/muster passages, headings and statute provisions, plus bounded whole-text searches; not whole-volume or every-word reading.
policy: Dyer is the Union starting source. Official State publications supplement omissions and retain conflicts. Statutes and aggregate returns are context until a unit-specific link is established. A later explicit description of an original contract may be evidence; a later reorganization is never used to infer it.
